info.name: Pathshala App API - Authentication
info.description: Login for all five roles. Open a role and run its 'First login' from the top: each request saves flow_token for the next, and Set PIN or PIN login saves that role's token. A number with a PIN gets 422 and error.next = pin_login from Send OTP, so use 'After login' or 'Forgot PIN' for it. While OTP_FIXED is set, every OTP is 123456. Fill in the username, password and student variables first; they are empty on purpose. Requests run against real data, so anything created here is real.

item.name: Student
item.description: Set student_id and class_code to a real student, and student_password to that student's password.

item.name: First login (contact OTP)
item.description: If the student does not know the password. The OTP goes to the contact number in the school records.

item.name: Send OTP to the contact number
Guest
item.description: Run only one of the two guest requests, then Set PIN.

item.name: Guest with a school from the list
Forgot PIN
item.description: After this request, run Verify OTP, Check student, a verify step and Set PIN from 'First login'. The old token stops working.

item.name: Send OTP to reset the PIN
Teacher
item.description: Set teacher_username and teacher_password to a login with user_type Teacher.

item.name: Guest ("Others" school)
item.description: For a school not in the list. No username or password. A number with a verified login cannot become a guest.

item.name: Forgot PIN
item.description: After this request, run Verify OTP, Verify username and password and Set PIN from 'First login'. The old token stops working.

item.name: Send OTP to reset the PIN
Guardian
item.description: No guest login. The child's OTP goes to the contact number in the school records, or to the login number if the child has no valid one. Uses student_id and class_code as the child.

item.name: Send OTP to the child's contact number
Forgot PIN
item.description: After this request, run Verify OTP, Check child, the two child OTP steps and Set PIN. The child must already be on the account from 'First login'. The old token stops working.

item.name: Send OTP to reset the PIN
Admin
item.description: No guest login. Set admin_username and admin_password to a login with user_type Admin. Super Admin logins are refused.

item.name: Forgot PIN
item.description: After this request, run Verify OTP, Verify username and password and Set PIN from 'First login'. The old token stops working.

item.name: Send OTP to reset the PIN
Staff
item.description: No guest login. Set staff_username and staff_password to a login with user_type Accountant.

item.name: Forgot PIN
item.description: After this request, run Verify OTP, Verify username and password and Set PIN from 'First login'. The old token stops working.

item.name: Send OTP to reset the PIN
